meta.title: Skills Settings
meta.description: View loaded user skills in settings.

ui.description: This setting applies only to DSH.
ui.empty: No loaded skills from this source.
ui.error: Could not load skills. Close and reopen this settings section to try again.
ui.incomplete: Some skill sources could not be loaded. This list may be incomplete.
ui.translationNotice: Expanding a skill automatically sends its description to the service selected in reasoning translation settings. Translations are cached using its target language.

ui.saveError: Could not save the setting. Close and reopen this section to check the saved state before trying again.
